'''Karsabi''' was an individual who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as one of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]]. Holding the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], Karsabi at one point took a mission to intercept a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] as it was headed to a [[Color/Legends|white]], ringed [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Star Wing" />
